scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && cd client && cp -r dist ../server/
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run dev:server
scripts.deploy: sh -c 'V=${1:-v1}; cd server && docker build -t sac-commenting-server:$V . && docker tag sac-commenting-server:$V europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-aib-dev-dna-sbx-alpha/gcf-artifacts/sac-commenting-server:$V && docker push europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-aib-dev-dna-sbx-alpha/gcf-artifacts/sac-commenting-server:$V' --
